reviews.title: Bought it for a server, works well enough
reviews.comment: firstly... BE AWARE THE ONLY TRUE x16 PCIe SLOT IS THE TOP ONE!!!! When I first setup my server, the GPU had some artifacting and I read a few reviews here saying to move the GPU down a slot. DO NOT DO THAT! I bricked my motherboard and had to get a replacement. Despite the motherboard having four x16 slots, only the top one has all the pins. If you look very closely with the motherboard in hand, you will see the other three are only wired for x1 and connect to the chipset. Besides that, neat motherboard!
